lines.zh: 这条路我走过，很久以前。
lines.en: I walked this road long ago.
A joint clicks and I shift half a step.
One charge of mine brings down a wall.

lines.zh: 祭坛的土，还压在我蹄下。
lines.en: Altar soil is still packed under my hooves.
Nothing living over there. Only fungus.

lines.zh: 一条腿是骨头，一条是菌。
lines.en: One leg is bone, the other is fungus.
Keep walking. Do not remember the village.

lines.zh: 我这身幽匿甲，撞得比劫掠兽狠。
lines.en: This sculk hide hits harder than a ravager's.
I once left blood marks along this road.

lines.zh: 幽匿的骨头，走起来有声。
lines.en: Sculk bone makes noise when it walks.
Sculk veins grow on my horns.

lines.zh: 四只蹄子，只有两只有知觉。
lines.en: Only two of my four hooves still feel.
Sculk hide does not burn in the sun.
Vibrations pulse up through the ground.
The fungus ate my name.

lines.zh: 我背上的鞍，还没有人骑。
lines.en: The saddle on me has never been ridden.
The vibrations stopped. I am still standing.

lines.zh: 生前四条腿，现在多了菌。
lines.en: Four legs before; now there is fungus too.
Mycelium has grown inside my eye sockets.
Even the echo in the cavern has stopped.
One rib is missing. Never mind.
No sound at all. It unsettles me.

lines.zh: 留下来，变成菌毯的一部分。
lines.en: Stay. Become part of the sculk mat.
Do not run, it changes nothing.
Before I lift a hoof, I size you up.
Sculk grows on my horns.

lines.zh: 劫掠兽记性差，可我记得。
lines.en: Ravagers forget — I don't.
You have a pulse. It is loud.
The torch lights me and the mycelium stirs.

lines.zh: 你那双眼睛，我还没长出来。
lines.en: Eyes like yours never grew on me.
When I lower my head, my horns reach you first.

lines.zh: 劫掠兽的皮，被菌撑开了。
lines.en: Fungus splits a ravager's hide.

lines.zh: 这躯壳借来的，别打散它。
lines.en: This shell is borrowed; do not scatter it.
After death, blows land duller.
A little pain came back. Strange.
Click... two ribs just broke.

lines.zh: 背上那层幽匿，就是我的伤。
lines.en: The sculk on my back is my wound.
The ground I tread turns color.
Fifty points of life, still plenty left.

lines.zh: 这一刀削掉我半块菌毯。
lines.en: That blade took half a patch of sculk off me.
One more step and I lunge.

lines.zh: 我的骨架，正在换成幽匿。
lines.en: My bones are turning to sculk.
The fungus is hungry. I can only feed it.
Put it down and do not watch me eat.
My jaw is grinding. That is me holding back.
That hand. Reach a little closer.
The gold is glowing. Why?
The smell I catch is living.
I cannot give up the warmth of the living.
I carry sculk on my back.
The smell of rot is like my own.
This meat reminds me of being alive.
Bumping me? Do you want to be assimilated?
Click... my shin bone has slipped out.

lines.zh: 你的护甲撞碎了一片幽匿。
lines.en: Your armor cracked a patch of sculk.

lines.zh: 蹄子别踩，菌毯下面是骨头。
lines.en: Easy on the hooves; bones lie under the sculk.
Watch the hoofprints, living one.
One ram and no apology needed.
This frame of mine tips over at a push.

lines.zh: 活物的热气，烫到我菌丝。
lines.en: Living warmth burns my mycelium.
My saddle rotted away long ago.

lines.zh: 五十点血，抵得上一整队。
lines.en: Fifty health is worth a whole squad.

lines.zh: 阴影里没有谁愿意靠近我。
lines.en: No one in the shadows wants to come near.

lines.zh: 死了就不怕我身上的菌了。
lines.en: Die, and my fungus will not frighten you.

lines.zh: 下一具身体，我会走快点。
lines.en: In the next body I will walk faster.
Half of me is missing and will not come back.
Closer… no. Stay there.
Two could sleep beneath the sculk.
Sculk hide keeps no warmth.

lines.zh: 劫掠兽的角，现在长着幽匿。
lines.en: Sculk grows on my ravager horns.
By the moon, I won't turn on you.

lines.zh: 不朽是这样：一直烂下去。
lines.en: Immortality means rotting on and on.

lines.zh: 拖回祭坛那边，压进土里。
lines.en: Drag it to the altar and press it into soil.

lines.zh: 蹄子夹不起东西，只能用嘴。
lines.en: Hooves cannot pinch; only my mouth can.

lines.zh: 石头上刻的字，我认不出。
lines.en: The marks cut in stone mean nothing to me.

lines.zh: 我撞过的墙，都塌了一半。
lines.en: Every wall I hit is half collapsed.

lines.zh: 谁掉的？进我的幽匿里了。
lines.en: Whose is this? Into my sculk it goes.
The saddlebag rotted; I carry it in my teeth.
Half a bone still in my jaws.
Hold it in your teeth; keep the mycelium off.

lines.zh: 这些东西，都该埋进菌里。
lines.en: All of this should be buried in the fungus.
This piece belongs to the sculk, not you.
Your heartbeat carries through the soil.
Living one — stand still.

lines.zh: 我这副架子，本来就是撞人的。
lines.en: This frame was built to ram.

lines.zh: 跑起来，菌就跟着你的脚。
lines.en: Run, and the sculk follows your feet.

lines.zh: 我的角已经低下来对着你。
lines.en: My horns are already lowered at you.

lines.zh: 劫掠兽的角，被幽匿包住。
lines.en: Sculk has sheathed the ravager's horns.
Tonight the sculk mat eats too.
I smell it. Within thirty paces.
This sculk mat does not welcome the living.
The vibration stopped. It is you.
The fungus has not touched you yet.
Sculk ravager. Stand still.
Infection takes only one touch.
I will keep the eyeballs. No waste.
My hooves tear up the sculk.
If I move first, you get no chance.
Those two feet are mine now.
Done panting? I am moving.
I never stop and never need to breathe.

lines.zh: 光里没有菌，你躲不住的。
lines.en: No fungus in the light, but it will not hide you.
Ahead lies the collapsed mouth of the altar.
Even the ravager's horns grow fungus.

lines.zh: 劫掠兽的骨，换成了幽匿。
lines.en: The ravager's bones are sculk now.

lines.zh: 你踩过的地方，都是我的。
lines.en: Everywhere you step is already mine.
I count every landing of your feet.

lines.zh: 我腿上的幽匿，替我咬着地。
lines.en: The sculk on my legs grips the ground for me.
Three more steps and the sculk reaches you.
Your sweat smells stronger than blood.
My four hooves sink the ground.
The sculk you crush will tell me where you are.
Falling would be better. Saves me the work.

lines.zh: 你脚底的振动，我全收着。
lines.en: I collect every vibration under your feet.

lines.zh: 停下。菌丝已经到你脚边。
lines.en: Stop. Mycelium is at your feet.
Turn your head. Look at my horn.

lines.zh: 我的背甲上，菌丝一层层。
lines.en: Layers of mycelium on my back plate.

lines.zh: 这片幽匿地我熟，跟着我。
lines.en: I know this sculk ground; follow me.

lines.zh: 你每跑一步，幽匿就更近。
lines.en: Every step you run, the sculk draws nearer.
My horn scoops and you fly.
Hooves land first, teeth right after.
You stepped back; good, keep going.
When I charge, the ground shakes.
I charge head down and the ground splits.
Fifty health, and the charge still lands hard.
You hit the ground and the dirt jumps.
One inch short.
Not much strength, but one charge is enough.
Whatever blocks the path gets smashed.

lines.zh: 我停不下来，这身体太沉。
lines.en: I cannot stop; this body is too heavy.
Mycelium has your ankle now.

lines.zh: 你的叫声震得菌丝发麻。
lines.en: Your screaming numbs the mycelium.
I charge, and the ground shakes.
The ground shakes when I charge.

lines.zh: 幽匿劫掠兽的角压下来。
lines.en: The sculk ravager's horns bear down.
Sculk grows on my horns.

lines.zh: 地表裂开，我从下面上来。
lines.en: The surface cracked and I came up.
Eyes open, and I already want something alive.
Heavy as I am, soil cannot hold me.

lines.zh: 这里以前有墙，现在是菌。
lines.en: Walls stood here once. Now it is fungus.
Fungus creeps over all four of my feet.
I take my stand and the grass blackens.
I rose out of the infection.

lines.zh: 四下无人，我先站一会儿。
lines.en: Nobody around. I will stand here a while.
Each hoofbeat spreads sculk.
This soil once buried me.
Only when my hooves find solid ground do I move.
Light a torch and the fungus shrinks into the dirt.

lines.zh: 又是这副劫掠兽的身体。
lines.en: This ravager body again.

lines.zh: 火在烧我的菌，我退不开。
lines.en: Fire eats my fungus and I cannot pull away.
Bone and sculk, scattered together.

lines.zh: 水渗进菌丝，我沉得更快。
lines.en: Water seeps through the sculk; I sink faster.
That blast carried far.

lines.zh: 箭杆插进菌毯，拔出来是黑的。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in the sculk and comes out black.

lines.zh: 紫光钻进菌丝，在里面烧。
lines.en: Violet light crawls into the sculk and burns.

lines.zh: 腐肉不够，菌丝开始吃我。
lines.en: Not enough carrion; the mycelium starts eating me.

lines.zh: 雷从甲片上一路滑过去。
lines.en: The bolt slid right off my plates.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有振动，只有空。
lines.en: In the void there is no vibration, only nothing.
